topics.title: Howard Discusses Radio Station Promo & Cope’s Outburst
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, Howard Stern praised an LA station’s promotional announcement while reacting to disc jockey Mark Cope’s controversial accusations about Joe Buttafuco. Cope went off-air making unverified claims based on police investigations regarding the allegations, leading to discussion of media reporting.

topics.title: Howard’s Hair and a Teenager – A Shaving Revelation
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Howard discusses his thinning hair and growing up, recalling when he first started shaving. A teenage caller shares their experience with developing facial hair, leading to humorous comparisons between Howard's situation and that of a schoolteacher, alongside discussions about body image and adolescent development.

topics.title: Library Perverts and Masturbation Calls
topics.summary: During a radio show, callers discussed incidents involving inappropriate behavior in Pace University’s library. One caller described witnessing a man masturbating while a student was present, highlighting vulnerability and security's lack of response; another call detailed similar incidents with alumni and a dollar 95 community service number offering sexual advice.

topics.title: Five Towns Snobbery & Leno Critique
topics.summary: During a radio segment, hosts reminisce about their time in the Five Towns neighborhood and its residents, describing them as ‘snobs.’ Howard Stern then criticizes Jay Leno’s approach to late-night television, arguing that Leno lacks an edge and doesn't engage with his audience effectively.

topics.title: Phone Call with Dr. Joyce Brothers
topics.summary: During a phone interview, Howard discusses his frustrations and personal assistant needs while engaging in an awkward conversation with Dr. Joyce Brothers about her past career as a game show contestant and views on female sexuality. The call takes a bizarre turn when she reveals details of a car incident involving swerving and indecent exposure.

topics.title: Desperate Women and the Ticket Quest
topics.summary: Two women engage in increasingly bizarre attempts to secure Eric Clapton tickets by offering unusual services like physical assessments and a request for nude hugging with Richard Simmons, ultimately devolving into crude commentary about their appearance and weight before abruptly ending.
